fields.description: Unique fingerprint that prevents the same planned maintenance from being generated twice.
fields.label: Identity Key

fields.description: Preventive maintenance plan whose schedule produced this occurrence.
fields.label: Maintenance Plan

fields.description: Version number of the maintenance plan that was active when this occurrence was generated.
fields.label: Plan Revision

fields.description: Stable identifier of the specific plan row (task) this occurrence was generated from.
fields.label: Plan Line

fields.description: Human-readable code of the plan task, used to match the occurrence back to its source line.
fields.label: Plan Line Code

fields.description: Specific piece of installed equipment this maintenance visit will service.
fields.label: Installed Equipment

fields.description: Customer who owns the equipment and receives this scheduled maintenance.
fields.label: Customer

fields.description: Operating company responsible for delivering this maintenance.
fields.label: Company

fields.description: Project this maintenance occurrence is tracked under, if any.
fields.label: Project

fields.description: Physical customer location where the equipment is installed and serviced.
fields.label: Customer Site

fields.description: Service contract that entitles the customer to this scheduled maintenance.
fields.label: Service Contract

fields.description: Category of maintenance work to be performed during this visit.
fields.label: Service Type

fields.description: Calendar date on which this maintenance is scheduled to fall due.
fields.label: Due Date

fields.description: Exact due moment stored in UTC for reliable cross-timezone scheduling.
fields.label: Due At UTC

fields.description: Timezone of the customer site used to interpret the local due date.
fields.label: Due Timezone

fields.description: Offset in minutes from UTC applied to the site timezone at the due moment.
fields.label: UTC Offset Minutes

fields.description: Date on which the system will automatically create the service job for this occurrence.
fields.label: Release On

fields.description: Number of days the occurrence may slip past its due date before it is flagged overdue.
fields.label: Grace Days

fields.description: When enabled, the service job is generated automatically on the release date.
fields.label: Auto Release Job

fields.description: Current lifecycle stage of the occurrence, from forecast through released to completed.
fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Forecast
Due
Released
Completed
Skipped
Cancelled
Overdue

fields.description: Timestamp when this occurrence was created by the scheduling engine.
fields.label: Generated On

fields.description: Service job that was created when this occurrence was released for execution.
fields.label: Released Job

fields.description: Internal key used to batch related occurrences into a single service visit.
fields.label: Grouping Key

fields.description: Earlier occurrence that this one replaces after a reschedule.
fields.label: Rescheduled From

fields.description: Explanation recorded when the occurrence is skipped or cancelled.
fields.label: Skip / Cancel Reason
